description: EXO represents solar wind as an exospheric electron-proton system. It uses kinetic distribution assumptions above an exobase to study outflow from coronal holes. The resource is documented by Belgian Institute for Space Aeronomy; Royal Belgian Institute for Space Aeronomy. The documented physical domain is Geospace, Exosphere; grid spacing, supported periods and cadence depend on this version and its chosen configuration. The documentation links Runs-on-Request. A software licence and any external distribution charge are not stated. Heavy ions are deferred to later code versions, and the sharp exobase simplifies a gradual physical transition. The documented space-weather effects make it a potential environmental input for infrastructure hazard exposure and resilience simulations. It is related to platform-nasa-ccmc in this catalogue. The cited documentation is available online; underlying files were not downloaded. Spatial and temporal resolution were not independently established.
